rules: Every entry is preserved with Java semantics except an explicitly versioned Teyru syntax delta.
Preview features are excluded and must produce a profile-aware diagnostic unless a future profile explicitly enables them.
Each obligation requires parser/semantic/emitter, javac differential, and source-map coverage where applicable.

chapterCoverage.positive: compile a non-preview Java 25 baseline fixture
chapterCoverage.negative: reject preview syntax without an enabled preview profile

chapterCoverage.positive: validate every Teyru grammar import against a named JLS syntactic category
chapterCoverage.negative: fail an undefined or lexical/syntactic-category-mismatched grammar import
illegal modifier, inheritance, constructor or member
illegal interface member or annotation target
illegal generic array and runtime store
illegal reachability, pattern or control transfer

chapterCoverage.positive: blank final, constructor, loop, switch and pattern definite assignment
chapterCoverage.negative: read-before-assignment, double final assignment and val reassignment

chapterCoverage.positive: parse one fixture for every reachable non-preview production
chapterCoverage.negative: undefined imported production and preview-only production

features.feature: JLS organization, relationship, references and preview boundary
features.preserve: Java SE 25 final-release non-preview scope; normative JLS clauses take precedence over examples
features.negative: preview syntax rejected without explicit future profile

features.feature: lexical and syntactic grammar notation and imported-category closure
features.preserve: JLS grammar category case, optionality, repetition and one-of meaning
features.positive: all imported JAVA_* categories resolve to JLS 25 productions
features.negative: undefined, misspelled or wrong-level imported production

features.feature: definite assignment and unassignment
features.preserve: Java flow rules for locals, blank final fields, constructors, expressions, statements, loops, switch and patterns; val follows final-local rules
features.positive: blank-final constructor paths, loop/switch/pattern assignment and initialized val
features.negative: read before assignment, second final/val write and incomplete constructor path

features.feature: complete Java SE 25 syntactic grammar import boundary
features.preserve: every retained Java production is reachable or explicitly excluded only because it is preview; Teyru deltas replace named productions
features.positive: production-to-fixture manifest covers every reachable JLS 19 category
features.negative: validator rejects missing production, dangling cross-reference or preview-only production

features.feature: Unicode input, escapes, and line terminators
features.preserve: translation order and raw-to-translated spans
features.positive: Unicode identifiers and escaped token data
features.negative: Unicode escape producing Teyru syntax semicolon

features.feature: tokens, whitespace, and comments
features.preserve: Java trivia and comment forms

features.feature: separators and operators

features.feature: type contexts and variables
features.preserve: final/effectively-final and definite assignment
features.positive: val local and Java var lambda parameter

features.feature: all Java conversions, promotion, boxing, unboxing and contexts
features.preserve: conversion timing, narrowing, overload and assignment results
